_meta.description: Page clean-name -> canonical category, applied first in inferCategoryMap. Patches the positional page-naming convention when a page's own name does not encode its category (a WIP-renamed or self-hosting icons page). Keys are clean-names (status emoji stripped) so they survive the emoji changing. `exclude` drops a page's components entirely (staging / not-ready). Self-retiring: delete an entry once Figma encodes the category natively and a re-sync restores it.
_meta.remove_when: Figma re-encodes these pages so the sync attributes their category natively; a re-sync then restores it and the entry can be deleted.
